# Overview

forcedlabor: Global Fishing Watch’s forced labor risk machine learning
algorithm ================

Updated: 2026-04-24

`forcedlabor` is an R package develop for training a positive–unlabeled
(PU) model to detect fishing vessels exhibiting behaviors or
characteristics consistent with forced-labor offenders.

The model is trained on a combination of confirmed cases of forced
labor, an unlabeled set of vessels for which there is no information
about the occurrence of forced labor (hence the **positive-unlabelled**
denomination), and the features of the model derive from Automatic
Identification System (AIS) data processed by Global Fishing Watch that
describes vessel characteristics and activity.

# Installation

You can install the most recent version of `forcedlabor` using:

``` r

# Check/install remotes
if (!require("remotes"))
  install.packages("remotes")

# Install the forcedlabor package

remotes::install_github("GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor",
                        dependencies = TRUE)
```

# Using the package

Check the package vignette for function descriptions and an example
workflow.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bag_downsample()`](https://github.com/GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor/reference/bag_downsample.md)
  : Apply downsample step to data recipe across defined seeds/bags
- [`calibrated_threshold()`](https://github.com/GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor/reference/calibrated_threshold.md)
  : Computes threshold for offender classification
- [`compute_D()`](https://github.com/GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor/reference/compute_D.md)
  : Compute D from MAX_SLOPE algorithm
- [`compute_alpha_star()`](https://github.com/GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor/reference/compute_alpha_star.md)
  : Compute alpha\*\_n from DEDPUL
- [`compute_r()`](https://github.com/GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor/reference/compute_r.md)
  : Computes density ratios array r
- [`conf_estimate()`](https://github.com/GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor/reference/conf_estimate.md)
  : Compute a confidence level estimate
- [`dedpul_estimation()`](https://github.com/GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor/reference/dedpul_estimation.md)
  : Computing the proportion of positives within the unlabeled
  (populationwise).
- [`fl_classification()`](https://github.com/GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor/reference/fl_classification.md)
  : Computes binary classification via DEDPUL
- [`fl_cvsetup()`](https://github.com/GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor/reference/fl_cvsetup.md)
  : Setting up data structure
- [`fl_hyperpar()`](https://github.com/GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor/reference/fl_hyperpar.md)
  : Get best hyperparameter combination for each common seed after ML
  training
- [`fl_perf_metrics()`](https://github.com/GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor/reference/fl_perf_metrics.md)
  : Computes recall for assessment sets and specificity for holdout non
  offenders
- [`fl_recall()`](https://github.com/GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor/reference/fl_recall.md)
  : Computes recall for assessment sets
- [`fl_rfsetup()`](https://github.com/GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor/reference/fl_rfsetup.md)
  : Setting up the model recipe and random forest specification
- [`fl_sample_data`](https://github.com/GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor/reference/fl_sample_data.md)
  : A sample of reported cases of forced labor
- [`fl_train()`](https://github.com/GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor/reference/fl_train.md)
  : Training forced labor random forest model.
- [`kernel_unlabeled()`](https://github.com/GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor/reference/kernel_unlabeled.md)
  : Computes density kernels estimated for positive and unlabeled, and
  the values of those densities inferred for unlabeled predictions
  (sorted)
- [`monotonize()`](https://github.com/GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor/reference/monotonize.md)
  : Enforcing partial monotonicity on r
- [`rolling_median()`](https://github.com/GlobalFishingWatch/forcedlabor/reference/rolling_median.md)
  : Smoothing r using a rolling median
